pages.title: Grand Warbell
pages.text: Right-click the bell to assign nearby recruited Illagers to $(l:raidborn:mechanics/settlement_mode)Settlement Mode$(/l). The default settlement area extends 48 blocks from the bell.

pages.title: Settlement Center
pages.text: Linked Illagers stop following the player, use beds and workstations, sleep, wander around the settlement, and may become available for trading.

pages.title: Obtaining
pages.text: The Grand Warbell is made with the $(l:raidborn:mechanics/transmutation_table)Transmutation Table$(/l). Breaking it removes Settlement Mode from nearby linked Illagers.
